name: Bob
fix_description: Same pattern as HackDao (bench-40): in _transfer, the sell fee is deducted from sender balance separately rather than from the transfer amount. This creates a discrepancy between pair token balance and reserves when skim is used. Fix: deduct fee from actualAmount (reduce what recipient receives) instead of separately reducing sender balance.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC chains a flash loan, router swaps, LP minting, repeated skim/swap cycles, callback-based pair interaction, and liquidity removal across multiple contracts, requiring understanding of Pancake/Uniswap V2 mechanics and fee-on-transfer token behavior. The exploit logic is non-obvious and protocol-specific, with a 5+ step attack flow that would likely take an experienced auditor more than 2 hours to reconstruct confidently.
